page.overview:
Who is Edgar Borroughs?

Edgar Borroughs was a fictional author. John Hammond was a fan of Borrough's books, so he named the Site B Village known as Borroughs after him. There is also a statue of him in the middle of the village, with his name being abbreviated as E.R. Borroughs on the plaque.
